comment:
* Wearable extender for notification actions. To add extensions to an action, * create a new {@link NotificationCompat.Action.WearableExtender} object using * the {@code WearableExtender()} constructor and apply it to a * {@link NotificationCompat.Action.Builder} using * {@link NotificationCompat.Action.Builder#extend}. * * 
         * NotificationCompat.Action action = new NotificationCompat.Action.Builder(
         *         R.drawable.archive_all, "Archive all", actionIntent)
         *         .extend(new NotificationCompat.Action.WearableExtender()
         *                 .setAvailableOffline(false))
         *         .build();

variables.name: EXTRA_WEARABLE_EXTENSIONS
variables.comment: Notification action extra which contains wearable extensions

variables.name: KEY_FLAGS
variables.comment: Keys within EXTRA_WEARABLE_EXTENSIONS for wearable options.

methods.comment:
* Set whether this action is available when the wearable device is not connected to
             * a companion device. The user can still trigger this action when the wearable device
             * is offline, but a visual hint will indicate that the action may not be available.
             * Defaults to true.

methods.name: public boolean isAvailableOffline()

             * Defaults to true.

             * @return this object for method chaining
